question: why does the company Oracle have 2 CEOs
answer: Based on the given passages, Oracle has two CEOs, Safra Catz and Mark Hurd, because Larry Ellison, the founder and former CEO, stepped down from his position.

citations.text: Oracle’s founder Larry Ellison has stepped down as CEO and has been replaced in the position by former HP CEO Mark Hurd and Safra Catz. Ellison’s new titles are Executive Chairman and Chief Technology Officer.Newslook.arry Ellison, center, smiles with now Oracle co-CEO Safra Catz, left, during the Oracle Open World conference on Oct. 25, 2006, in San Francisco.

SAN FRANCISCO — Larry Ellison announced Thursday he has agreed to step down as CEO of Oracle, the software powerhouse he co-founded.Mark Hurd and Safra Catz, co-presidents of Oracle, will take the role as CEO.arry Ellison, center, smiles with now Oracle co-CEO Safra Catz, left, during the Oracle Open World conference on Oct. 25, 2006, in San Francisco.

On Thursday, Oracle's Larry Ellison unexpectedly announced that he was stepping down from his CEO post and naming not one, but two CEOs to replace him. Co-president and CFO Safra Catz and co-president Mark Hurd will share the role of CEO.Oracle isn't the first major company to tap more than one CEO at the same time.Chipotle, Whole Foods, and Deutsche Bank are also run by two CEOs. Samsung even has three of them.erman companies Deutsche Bank and SAP both have two CEOs (though SAP co-CEO Jim Hagemann Snabe will step down to the supervisory board in May).
